table.retrieve:
SELECT
	item.customicode,
	purorderdetail.alternatecustomicode,
	currlistrow = 0,
	purorderdetail.pocode,   
	itemname = item.name,
	itempacking = itempacking.name,
	manufname = manufacturer.name,
	itemcategory = itemcategory.name,
	itemclass = itemclass.name,
	genericitem = genericitem.name,
	purorderdetail.icode,   
	purorderdetail.bonusqty,   
	purorderdetail.rate,
	purorderdetail.soldqty,
	purorderdetail.returnqty,
	netsaleqty=purorderdetail.soldqty - purorderdetail.returnqty,
	purorderdetail.packunits,
	avgsaleqty = 
			case purorderheader.purordercatcode when 1 then 0 when 3 then 0 
			else (purorderdetail.soldqty - purorderdetail.returnqty) / 
				case datediff(dy, purorderheader.startdate, purorderheader.enddate)
				when 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE convert(numeric(10,2), datediff(dy, purorderheader.startdate, purorderheader.enddate)) 
				END
			END,
	forecastqty = 
			CAST(case purorderheader.purordercatcode when 1 then 0 when 3 then 0
			else ceiling(((purorderdetail.soldqty - purorderdetail.returnqty) / 
				case datediff(dy, purorderheader.startdate, purorderheader.enddate)
				when 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE convert(numeric(15,4), datediff(dy, purorderheader.startdate, purorderheader.enddate)) 
				END) * purorderheader.projectionperiod) 
			END AS numeric(15,4)),
	purorderdetail.stock,
	purorderdetail.PORowID,   
	looseqty = 
			case purorderheader.purordercatcode when 1 then purorderdetail.OptimumQty - purorderdetail.stock + purorderdetail.transitstock
			else 0 end ,
	purorderdetail.remarks,   
	purorderdetail.batch,
	allowedqty = 999999.0000,
	purorderdetail.qty,
	purorderdetail.itemflatdisc,
	purorderdetail.packsalestax,
	purorderdetail.gstperc,
	purorderdetail.foreignprice,
	purorderdetail.purprice,
	purorderdetail.saleprice,
	purorderdetail.rpp,
	purorderdetail.packavgprice,
	purorderdetail.transitstock,
	purorderdetail.saleorderrequest,
	purorderdetail.LastPurInvCode,
	purorderdetail.LastPurDate,
	purorderdetail.minqty,
	purorderdetail.ReOrderQty,
	purorderdetail.OptimumQty,
	purorderdetail.discperc2,
	itemalertcode=purorderdetail.itemalertcode,
	purorderdetail.discperc
FROM	
	purorderdetail,  
	purorderheader, 
	item
	LEFT OUTER JOIN itempacking ON (item.packcode = itempacking.packcode),
	manufacturer,
	itemcategory,
	itemclass,
	genericitem
WHERE 
	( dbo.purorderheader.pocode = :ra_POCode ) and
	( dbo.purorderheader.pocode = purorderdetail.pocode ) and  
	( purorderdetail.icode = item.icode ) and  
	( item.manfcode = manufacturer.manfcode )  and
	( item.icatcode = itemcategory.icatcode )  and
	( item.iccode = itemclass.iccode ) and
	( item.genericcode = genericitem.genericcode )
ORDER BY	
	purorderdetail.PORowID

objects.expression: SUM( round(( c_amount * gstperc * 0.01),2) for all)
